question: Should `subagents list` gain a public read-only `depth`/`recursive` API now, and what exact rows may the root controller see without gaining control over grandchildren?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested tool/slash flags and descendant visibility become a public agent/session API contract with control-boundary implications.

options.title: Approve narrow read-only depth listing
options.body: Add a default-compatible depth/recursive list mode that returns descendant rows with parent/depth metadata but keeps mutation commands limited to directly controlled runs.

options.title: Defer to broader hierarchy design
options.body: Wait for the session-chain and active-agent-tree work to define one lineage/traversal contract before adding another public list shape.

options.title: Use existing flat session surfaces only
options.body: Keep `subagents list` direct-only and document `sessions_list`/childSessions as the supported inspection path for now.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow read-only depth listing
recommendation.body: Add a default-compatible depth/recursive list mode that returns descendant rows with parent/depth metadata but keeps mutation commands limited to directly controlled runs.
